g.title: SPLIT
g.text: Star point for the 12 V rail; one supply feeds both nodes.

g.title: ESC0
g.text: TBD-1..3 on J3, TBD-4..9 on J8; pin numbers from UM2516. PA2/PA3/PA4 may not be free GPIO — NOTES.md #3.

g.title: W_PH0
g.text: Motor 0 phases. Keep short and twisted; route clear of W_ENC0.

g.title: W_ENC0
g.text: Motor 0 encoder SPI. Shield grounded at the ESC end only. Noise here becomes angle glitches that the FOC loop will act on.

g.title: W_UART0
g.text: 921600 baud, stick controller to motor node 0. TX/RX cross over. Common GND required.

g.title: ESC1
g.text: Same firmware and pin map as ESC0 — nodes differ only by which stick-controller UART they land on.

g.title: W_PH1
g.text: Motor 1 phases. Keep short and twisted; route clear of W_ENC1.

g.title: W_ENC1
g.text: Motor 1 encoder SPI. Same shielding rules as W_ENC0.

g.title: W_UART1
g.text: 921600 baud, stick controller to motor node 1. Same rules as W_UART0.

g.title: MOT0
g.text: Phase order sets direction. If an axis is inverted, swap two phases OR flip the sign in mixing.cpp — not both.

g.title: ENC0
g.text: Diametric magnet centred on the motor 0 rotor shaft end.

g.title: ENC1
g.text: Diametric magnet centred on the motor 1 rotor shaft end.

g.title: MCU
g.text: link1 asks for PC10/PC11, which do not exist on UFQFPN48 — NOTES.md #1. link0 collides with Serial1 — NOTES.md #2. Throttle has no ADC pin in firmware — NOTES.md #4.

g.title: W_POT
g.text: Throttle pot. Destination ADC pin unassigned — NOTES.md

g.title: W_USB
g.text: USB-C data cable to the host PC.

g.title: POT
g.text: Throttle lever position. 100 nF wiper-to-GND recommended.

g.title: HOST
g.text: Enumerates as HID joystick "FFB_Flight_Stick" (X = roll, Y = pitch).
